quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #18
										  					
  

35 Questions • Passing Score 30

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must yield when turning left on green.
One-way traffic.
Cattle crossing.
Two-way left turn lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must yield when turning left on green.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to yield when turning left on a green light. Let oncoming traffic pass first, then turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?

options.text: Stop
Wrong way
Yield
Do not enter

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and oncoming vehicles go first. Only stop if needed.

questions.question: What does a single broken white line in the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. You cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. You can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. You cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction. You can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction. You can pass when safe.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. A broken line means you can pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: Your wheels drop off the road onto the shoulder. What should you do?

options.text: Brake hard and turn sharply back onto the road.
Stop your car on the edge of the road.
Slow down and carefully turn back onto the road.
Keep your speed and turn sharply back onto the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and carefully turn back onto the road.
questions.explanation: Reduce your speed without hard braking. Carefully steer back onto the road. Watch for other traffic as you return to the road.

questions.question: How should you wear your seat belt's shoulder strap?

options.text: Behind your back.
Loosely.
Under your arm.
Tight with no slack.

questions.correctAnswerText: Tight with no slack.
questions.explanation: Your shoulder and lap belts must be tight. The shoulder belt goes over your shoulder and across your chest. Never put it behind your back or under your arm.

questions.question: What helps someone recover from drinking alcohol?

options.text: Tomato juice and lime.
Hot coffee.
Fresh air.
Only time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only time.
questions.explanation: Only time will reduce the effects of alcohol in the body. Nothing else speeds up this process.

questions.question: When turning left at an intersection, must you yield to a bicyclist coming from the opposite direction?

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: True
questions.explanation: Yes. Yield to oncoming bicycles the same way you yield to oncoming cars. Keep your wheels straight while waiting to turn and go when the road is clear.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?

options.text: Make left turns.
Make U-turns.
Pass slow-moving traffic.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make left turns.
questions.explanation: The center lane is only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it to pass other vehicles or drive through traffic.

questions.question: Can 10 mph ever be too fast for safe driving?

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: True
questions.explanation: Drive slower than the speed limit when needed for safety. Bad weather, heavy traffic, or poor visibility may require you to drive as slow as 10 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead ends.
You must turn either right or left.
A four-way intersection is ahead.
A road is joining from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What is the DMV's vision standard?

options.text: 20/20 or better vision in one or both eyes.
20/40 or better vision in one or both eyes.
20/60 or better vision in one or both eyes.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: 20/40 or better vision in one or both eyes.
questions.explanation: To get an unrestricted driver license, you must have 20/40 or better vision in one or both eyes. You must also have at least 110 degrees of horizontal vision in one or both eyes.

questions.question: What affects your ability to stop?

options.text: Signal lights.
Other cars on the road.
The time of day.
The condition of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: The condition of the road.
questions.explanation: Road conditions greatly affect how well you can stop. Slow down when roads are wet, icy, or slippery to stay in control. Driving too fast on poor roads makes it harder to stop and increases your risk of a crash.

questions.question: What happens when you drive while distracted?

options.text: It is never dangerous.
You react more slowly to hazards.
You usually drive faster.
It is only dangerous for young drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: You react more slowly to hazards.
questions.explanation: Distractions slow your reaction time to traffic and road hazards. Distracted driving is never safe.

questions.question: When you see or hear an emergency vehicle coming, what should you do?

options.text: Stop immediately and let the vehicle pass.
Drive to the right side of the road as safely as you can and stop.
Drive slowly and let the vehicle pass.
Keep moving slowly on the right side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive to the right side of the road as safely as you can and stop.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle is using lights or a siren, move to the right side of the road as quickly and safely as possible and stop. Do not stop in an intersection. Let the emergency vehicle pass before you continue driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: One-way traffic.
Intersection ahead.
Traffic is merging from the right.
The highway curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is entering the road from the right side.

questions.question: When you hear a siren or see flashing lights from an emergency vehicle, what must you do?

options.text: Slow down until it passes you.
Drive to the right side of the road and stop.
Wave the emergency vehicle to pass you.
Merge into the right lane and keep driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive to the right side of the road and stop.
questions.explanation: You must give the right-of-way to any emergency vehicle using lights or a siren. Drive immediately to the right side of the road and stop. If you are in an intersection, drive through it first before stopping on the right side.

questions.question: What causes many crashes?

options.text: Drivers going too fast for road conditions.
Drivers checking their mirrors and blind spots.
Drivers yielding the right-of-way.
Drivers keeping a four-second following distance.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers going too fast for road conditions.
questions.explanation: Many crashes happen because drivers go too fast for the conditions. Always drive at or below the speed limit and slow down when conditions are poor.

questions.question: As alcohol builds up in your blood, what happens?

options.text: Your reactions slow down.
You feel less confident.
Your body breaks it down faster.
You make fewer driving errors.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your reactions slow down.
questions.explanation: As alcohol builds up in your system, it slows your reaction time, makes you feel overly confident, and causes you to make more mistakes while driving.

questions.question: What does a double solid yellow line down the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions and passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in opposite directions and passing is allowed when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction and passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in the same direction and passing is allowed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in opposite directions and passing is not allowed.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A solid line means you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: When parallel parking between two cars, what should you do first?

options.text: Turn your wheels to the left.
Turn your wheels to the right.
Pull up even with the car in front of your desired parking space.
Back slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull up even with the car in front of your desired parking space.
questions.explanation: First, pull up next to the car in front of the space you want. Check traffic and signal. Then turn your wheels and back into the space.

questions.question: What should you do if a traffic light is not working?

options.text: Park your vehicle off the road and wait for power to return.
Use hand signals to tell other drivers what you plan to do.
Turn on hazard lights and drive through without stopping.
Treat it like a four-way stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a four-way stop.
questions.explanation: When a traffic light is broken, treat the intersection as a four-way stop. Take turns with other drivers and go through carefully when it is your turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must turn.
Turn right at the intersection.
Parking area ahead.
A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming ahead.

questions.question: What kind of sign is diamond-shaped?

options.text: A road hazard sign.
An interstate route sign.
A school crossing sign.
A speed limit sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road hazard sign.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs are yellow (or orange in work areas) and warn you of hazards or places where special rules apply.

questions.question: You are driving in the right lane and want to move to the left lane. What should you do?

options.text: Check your rearview mirror for traffic behind you.
Look over your left shoulder to check your blind spot.
Check your side mirror and turn on your signal.
Do all of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do all of the above.
questions.explanation: Always check your rearview mirror, side mirror, and blind spot by looking over your shoulder. Signal every time you change lanes.

questions.question: Two drivers arrive at the same time at a four-way stop. Who has the right-of-way?

options.text: The driver on the right.
The driver on the left.
One driver can drive without stopping.
One driver should honk to give up the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver on the right.
questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, yield to the driver on your right if you both arrive at the same time. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: When must you stop for a school bus?

options.text: When it is parked on the side of the road with no children inside.
Every time it approaches you, even if lights are not flashing.
When you are on a two-lane road and its red lights are flashing.
Whenever the driver waves at you.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you are on a two-lane road and its red lights are flashing.
questions.explanation: Stop when you see a school bus with flashing red lights on a two-lane road. Traffic from both directions must stop while the lights flash and the stop arm is out.

questions.question: What should you do while backing up?

options.text: Only use your mirrors.
Flash your lights.
Open your door to see if it is safe.
Turn your head and look through the rear window.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look through the rear window.
questions.explanation: Always look through the rear window by turning your head. Children and small objects are hard to see from your seat. Do not rely only on mirrors or sensors.

questions.question: What is defensive driving?

options.text: Spotting dangerous situations and acting to prevent accidents.
Passing bad drivers by getting ahead of them.
Following the car ahead at a close distance.
Quickly changing lanes and weaving through traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Spotting dangerous situations and acting to prevent accidents.
questions.explanation: Defensive driving means you notice dangerous situations early and take action before an accident happens. It helps you stay safe from reckless, careless, or impaired drivers.

questions.question: What do two solid yellow lines mean?

options.text: Passing is allowed from both directions.
Passing is not allowed.
Passing is allowed at the top of a hill.
Passing is allowed during the day only.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is not allowed.
questions.explanation: Two solid yellow lines mean traffic is moving toward each other. Never cross these lines to pass from either direction.

questions.question: Which of the following distracts drivers and increases crash risk?

options.text: CD player
Radio
Cell phone
All of the above

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above
questions.explanation: Cell phones, radios, and CD players can all distract you while driving. Even hands-free phones take your attention away from the road and increase crash risk.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for drunk drivers.
Curves ahead.
Slippery when wet.
Apply your brakes quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when it gets wet.

questions.question: What must you do at a red traffic light?

options.text: Stop at the stop line.
Stop before entering any crosswalk.
Stop before entering the intersection.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: A red light means you must stop. You must stop at the stop line, before any crosswalk, and before entering the intersection.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A left curve is ahead.
A series of curves is ahead.
An S-curve is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: Your wheels slip off the edge of the road. What should you do?

options.text: Jerk the steering wheel to force the vehicle back onto the pavement.
Speed up and steer back onto the pavement gradually.
Slam on your brakes and stop.
Gently brake to slow down. Then carefully steer back onto the pavement at a safe speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Gently brake to slow down. Then carefully steer back onto the pavement at a safe speed.
questions.explanation: If your wheels leave the road, slow down gently by pressing the brakes lightly. Once you are going slower, turn the steering wheel slowly to get back on the pavement. Do not jerk the wheel or brake hard.
